notes: Fixed: on a phone, a first-time player could not get past the "Play it as an app" screen in the browser, and the Install button on the title screen did nothing. Settings now also opens from the title screen, as promised in 1.20.0.

Taps land where you meant them (#44): a tap only presses the button it started on, nothing behind a menu that opened or closed mid-tap counts, a toast that pops up under your thumb ignores taps for half a second, and panels no longer redraw under your finger.

The world map draws much lighter (#43). The detailed coastline is now painted once into an image and reused, also when zoomed in, instead of being redrawn every frame. This should fix the garbled map on Firefox for Android, and makes zooming smoother on every phone.
Cairo now reaches the Middle East overland across the Sinai, like Istanbul does across the Bosporus (#47), at the same intercontinental price.
The Tier 1 label shows what you are now (#46): buy transit again or lose a Tier 1 PNI and it drops, with a message saying why. Your Tier 1 badge stays.
When an update adds new networks, you get a free 60-day courtesy route to the ones you cannot reach yet (#46), so your reach no longer drops overnight. Saves from before this version get it too.
Unplugged optics go on a spares shelf instead of in the bin (#45): the next channel of that type uses a spare for free, or you can sell spares on eBuy for 40% of their price.
